$comment: Connection-standard port declaration for this organ's decide(state, context). `inputs` are the keys decide() reads from `state`; `outputs` are the keys it writes under the top-level `output` object. Types map to the vocabulary in types.json. `rationale` and `self_metric` are contract-level envelope fields (every organ returns them) and are NOT ports. `context` carries no declared keys for this organ. NOTE: `issue_number`/`window_hours`/`now` are only consulted when `mode == "issue"`, but decide() fail-safes when they are absent (it returns the conservative `seed` verdict), so no input is unconditionally required — all are declared required:false.
